Alternatives Considered in DEIs
Preferred Plan.
The Preferred Plan proposed a variety of uses for the site including a fire station, industrial uses, general and technical offices, retail stores, a hotel, and market rate residential uses.
The location of the uses on the site has been defined only generally. Industrial uses and the parking structures would be located on the quadrangle and the remainder of the uses with exception of the fire station would be located on the triangle. In all "Build" Plans the fire station is located to the northwest of the Western Connector. Although the distribution of uses on the triangle is flexible, it has been indicated that the office uses would probably be concentrated in the western part of the site and the hotel and residential uses on the eastern part.

Task Force Plan.
The Task Force Plan proposed that the entire site be used primarily for industrial uses with some general and technical office and retail uses permitted. Industrial uses would be located on both the quadrangle and the triangle. The office and retail uses would be located on the triangle. The same street network is proposed as for the Preferred Plan.
City Manager's Plan.
This plan is similar to the Preferred Plan except for the following:
1. Residential uses are not included*.
2. The amount of hotel and retail uses is somewnat less than proposed in the Preferred Plan.
3. The amount of industrial and technical office uses is greater than proposed in the Preferred Plan.
4. The parking structure is located on the triangle.
Maximum Plan.
